"""Private native CDC publication owner; normal generator stays unchanged."""
from silverstar_fccg.generator.ground_pc_usb_cdc import PcUsbCdc_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeC_FunctionSpanGet


def NativePcAdapter_Render(*, indexed: bool) -> str:
    adapter = PcUsbCdc_Render().replace('#include "pc_byte_stream.h"',
        '#include "pc_byte_stream.h"\n#include "native_runtime.h"\n#include "native_clock.h"', 1)
    marker = '    if ((hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state != USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) ||'
    if adapter.count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native PC publication gate owner changed')
    adapter = adapter.replace(marker, '    if (NativeRuntime_ReadyGet() == 0U)\n'
        '    { __set_PRIMASK(saved_mask); return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_BUSY; }\n'+marker, 1)
    start, _opening, end = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(adapter, 'PcByteStream_WriteSession')
    write = adapter[start:end]
    marker = '    saved_mask = __get_PRIMASK();'
    if write.count(marker) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Native PC write context owner changed')
    write = write.replace(marker, '''    /* The native tick must advance before publication. Probe with interrupts
     * enabled; recheck READY/session below after taking the publication lock. */
    if ((NativeRuntime_ReadyGet() == 0U) || (NativeClock_ContextAllowedGet() == 0U))
    { return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_BUSY; }
    if (NativeClock_DelayUs(1U) != NativeClockResult_Ok)
    { return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_ERROR; }
'''+marker, 1)
    adapter = adapter[:start]+write+adapter[end:]
    if indexed:
        adapter = adapter.replace('hUsbDeviceFS.pClassData', 'hUsbDeviceFS.pClassDataCmsit[0]')
        marker='    if ((hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state != USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) ||'
        adapter = adapter.replace(marker,
            '    if ((hUsbDeviceFS.dev_state == USBD_STATE_CONFIGURED) &&\n'
            '        ((hUsbDeviceFS.classId != 0U) || (hUsbDeviceFS.pClassDataCmsit[0] == NULL) ||\n'
            '         (hUsbDeviceFS.pClassData != hUsbDeviceFS.pClassDataCmsit[0])))\n'
            '    { NativeRuntime_TransportFaultRecord(); __set_PRIMASK(saved_mask); return PC_BYTE_STREAM_WRITE_ERROR; }\n'
            +marker, 1)
    return adapter

"""Explicit private source-profile config; no broad missing-macro defaults."""
import hashlib
import difflib
import re
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_classic_cdc import NATIVE_PREFIX


def NativeUsbConfig_FilesRender(files, owners):
    expected=owners['usbd_conf.c'].removesuffix('.c')+'.h'
    paths=[p for p in files if p.rsplit('/',1)[-1]=='usbd_conf.h']
    if paths!=[expected]:raise ValueError('Native explicit USB config needs one header beside its LL owner')
    path=paths[0];original=files[path]
    if hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()!='99dcff1bcbf4fbda59073bbc32ec34c61fbf7cbc0456c4f42b568078dee56fdf':
        raise ValueError('Native explicit USB configuration needs reviewed header source profile')
    source=original.decode('utf-8-sig')
    for name in ('USBD_CLASS_BOS_ENABLED','USBD_USER_REGISTER_CALLBACK'):
        if re.search(r'(?m)^\s*#\s*(?:define|undef)\s+'+name+r'\b',source):
            raise ValueError('Native explicit USB option has an existing owner: '+name)
    anchor='#define USBD_LPM_ENABLED     0U'
    if source.count(anchor)!=1:raise ValueError('Native USB configuration anchor changed')
    source=source.replace(anchor,anchor+'''
/* Private single-FS-CDC contract: no class BOS facility or user callback registry.
 * Both choices are explicit and compiled under the unchanged -Wundef policy. */
#define USBD_CLASS_BOS_ENABLED 0U
#define USBD_USER_REGISTER_CALLBACK 0U
''',1)
    target='HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeConfig/'+path;derived=source.encode()
    patch=target+'.patch'
    rendered={target:derived,patch:''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),
        source.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile=NATIVE_PREFIX+path,tofile=NATIVE_PREFIX+path)).encode()}
    manifest={'original':NATIVE_PREFIX+path,'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),
        'derived':target,'derived_sha256':hashlib.sha256(derived).hexdigest(),
        'patch':patch,'patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rendered[patch]).hexdigest(),
        'explicit_options':{'USBD_CLASS_BOS_ENABLED':0,'USBD_USER_REGISTER_CALLBACK':0},
        'scope':'Recognized native header profile only; retain static allocator and fixed native class callbacks'}
    return rendered,target.rsplit('/',1)[0],manifest

"""F103 ordinary control integration composed with existing native bulk fixes.

No independent USB security acceptance is asserted. Original ST inputs remain
unchanged; combined derivatives and original-to-final patches are recorded.
"""
import hashlib, json, difflib
from silverstar_fccg.generator.ground_usb_control import NativeControl_Integrate,NativeControl_Definitions_Validate
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_usb_data import _FUNCTIONS,_HELPERS
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeC_FunctionSpanGet
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.native_classic_cdc import NATIVE_PREFIX

def _Replace(source,name,replacement):
    start,_opening,end=NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(source,name)
    return source[:start]+replacement+source[end:]

def NativeF103Control_Integrate(files,native,proof,replacements,callback_owned,bulk):
    callback=proof['cdc']['owners']['usbd_cdc_if.c']
    temporary={NATIVE_PREFIX+p:b for p,b in native.items()}
    temporary[NATIVE_PREFIX+callback]=files[callback_owned]
    changed=NativeControl_Integrate(temporary,NATIVE_PREFIX+callback,native[callback],
        library_prefix=NATIVE_PREFIX+'Middlewares/ST/STM32_USB_Device_Library/',
        reviewed_prefix='HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeControl/')
    NativeControl_Definitions_Validate(proof['build']['defines'])
    manifest=json.loads(temporary['Generated/usb_control_manifest.json'])
    for name in ('usbd_cdc.c','usbd_core.c'):
        original=proof['cdc']['owners'][name]
        path=changed[NATIVE_PREFIX+original]
        text=temporary[path].decode()
        bulk_text=files[replacements[NATIVE_PREFIX+original]].decode()
        if name=='usbd_cdc.c':
            text=text.replace('#include "usbd_cdc.h"','#include "usbd_cdc.h"\n#include "pc_byte_stream.h"\n#include <string.h>',1)
            for function,replacement in _FUNCTIONS.items():
                if function=='USBD_CDC_Init':
                    replacement=replacement.replace('  memset(hcdc, 0, sizeof(*hcdc));','  memset(hcdc, 0, sizeof(*hcdc));\n  hcdc->CmdOpCode = 0xFFU;')
                text=_Replace(text,function,replacement)
            start,_opening,_end=NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(text,'USBD_CDC_Init')
            text=text[:start]+_HELPERS+'\n'+text[start:]
        else:
            for function in ('USBD_Init','USBD_Start','USBD_ClrClassConfig','USBD_Stop'):
                start,_opening,end=NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(bulk_text,function)
                text=_Replace(text,function,bulk_text[start:end])
            for stage in ('DataIn','DataOut'):
                old='    pdev->pClass->'+stage+'(pdev, epnum);'
                new=('    uint8_t result = pdev->pClass->'+stage+'(pdev, epnum);\n'
                     '    return (result == USBD_OK) ? USBD_OK :\n'
                     '        ((result == USBD_BUSY) ? USBD_BUSY : USBD_FAIL);')
                if text.count(old)!=1:raise ValueError('F103 bulk/control composition owner differs')
                text=text.replace(old,new,1)
        temporary[path]=text.encode()
        entry=next(e for e in manifest['vendor_patches'] if e['derived_path']==path)
        patch=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(native[original].decode().replace('\r\n','\n').splitlines(True),
            text.splitlines(True),fromfile=entry['original_path'],tofile=path)).encode()
        temporary[entry['patch_path']]=patch
        entry['derived_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(temporary[path]).hexdigest()
        entry['patch_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest()
        bulk_entry=next(e for e in bulk['entries'] if e['original']==NATIVE_PREFIX+original)
        bulk_entry.update(derived=path,derived_sha256=entry['derived_sha256'],
            patch=entry['patch_path'],patch_sha256=entry['patch_sha256'])
    manifest.update(independent_review='NO_PASSED_OUTCOME',formal_release=False,
        bulk_composition='Existing native bulk init/deinit/LL failure and session ownership retained')
    temporary['Generated/usb_control_manifest.json']=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2).encode()
    files.update({p:b for p,b in temporary.items() if p.startswith(('Generated/','HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeControl/'))})
    replacements.update(changed)
    bulk['ep0']='Shared F103 control ordinary code integrated; independent safety review has NO PASSED OUTCOME; complete EP0/async lifecycle NOT PROVEN'
    files['HardwareGenerated/ReviewedNativeBulk/manifest.json']=json.dumps(bulk,indent=2).encode()
    return manifest

def test_only_retained_members_have_full_space_containing_archive_paths(gate,tmp_path):
    archive=tmp_path/'tool chain'/'libc_nano.a';archive.parent.mkdir();archive.write_bytes(b'reviewed archive identity')
    memory='''Archive member included to satisfy reference by file (symbol)
{archive}(libc_a-mallocr.o)
Discarded input sections
 .text._malloc_r 0x00000000 0x80 {archive}(libc_a-mallocr.o)
Linker script and memory map
 *libc.a(*)
 .text.memcpy
                0x08000020 0x30 {archive}(libc_a-memcpy.o)
 .debug_info    0x00000000 0x90 {archive}(libc_a-mallocr.o)
 .text.zero     0x08000060 0x0 {archive}(libc_a-mallocr.o)
 .text.outside  0x09000000 0x40 {archive}(libc_a-mallocr.o)
 .text.memcpy   0x08000020 0x30 {archive}(libc_a-memcpy.o)
 .bss.filler    0x20000000 0x0
 .bss.__sf      0x20000100 0x138 {archive}(libc_a-findfp.o)
'''.format(archive=archive.as_posix())
    result=gate.NativeLinkedLibraries_Inspect(memory,[{'origin':0x08000000,'length':65536},
        {'origin':0x20000000,'length':20480}])
    assert len(result)==2 and {item['object'] for item in result}=={'libc_a-memcpy.o','libc_a-findfp.o'}
    assert all(item['archive']==archive.as_posix() and item['archive_sha256']==
        hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for item in result)


def test_incomplete_or_missing_archive_inventory_cannot_pass(gate,tmp_path):
    regions=[{'origin':0x08000000,'length':65536}]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='one memory map'):
        gate.NativeLinkedLibraries_Inspect('LOAD libc.a',regions)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='no retained members'):
        gate.NativeLinkedLibraries_Inspect('Linker script and memory map\n *libc.a(*)\n',regions)

        gate.NativeLinkedLibraries_Inspect('Linker script and memory map\n .text.x 0x08000020 0x20 '+
            (tmp_path/'missing lib.a').as_posix()+'(x.o)\n',regions)

    irq_evidence=Path(os.environ.get("SILVERSTAR_VENDOR_IRQ_REPOSITORY", "D:/Tools/Embedded/STM32/Repository"))/package/"Drivers/CMSIS/Device/ST"/family/"Include"/header
    if not irq_evidence.is_file():pytest.fail("independent installed vendor IRQ header missing: "+str(irq_evidence))
    irq_text=re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/|//[^\r\n]*','',irq_evidence.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),flags=re.S)
    irq_numbers=tuple((n,int(v)) for n,v in re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(\w+_IRQn)\s*=\s*(-?\d+)\s*(?=,|\})",irq_text))
    if request.param=="f407-usb":
        assert dict(irq_numbers)['FPU_IRQn']==81  # Final enumerator has no comma.
    facts=NativeDeviceFacts(*values,str(evidence),hashlib.sha256(evidence.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                            fpu="fpv4-sp-d16" if request.param=="f407-usb" else "",
                            irq_numbers=irq_numbers,irq_header_sha256=hashlib.sha256(irq_evidence.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                            irq_evidence_source=str(irq_evidence))
    root=tmp_path/"native"; shutil.copytree(source,root)
    return root,dict(device_facts=facts,spi_resource="SPI1",gpio_resources=(nss,"RADIO_RST","RADIO_BUSY","RADIO_DIO1"))

@pytest.mark.parametrize("change",["missing-cdc","make-expression","CPU","ABI","memory","device-macro",
    "startup","USBX","class","RTOS","dynamic-allocation","unknown-hook","spi-owner","tick",
    "include-escape","linker-dependency","make-append","memory-expression",
    "spi-unknown-abi","spi-mixed-qualifier","reset-owner","facts-fpu"])
def test_incompatible_inputs_rejected(native,change):
    root,args=native; make=root/"Makefile"; text=make.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if change=="missing-cdc": (root/"USB_DEVICE/App/usbd_cdc_if.c").unlink()
    elif change=="make-expression": make.write_text(text.replace("Core/Src/main.c","$(shell whoami)",1),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="CPU": make.write_text(text.replace("-mcpu="+args["device_facts"].core,"-mcpu=cortex-m7"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="ABI": make.write_text(text+"\nFLOAT-ABI = -mfloat-abi=hard\n",encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="memory": args["device_facts"]=replace(args["device_facts"],regions=(NativeMemoryRegion("FLASH",0x08000000,999),))
    elif change=="device-macro": make.write_text(text.replace("-D"+args["device_facts"].device_macro,"-DSTM32UNKNOWN"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="startup": args["device_facts"]=replace(args["device_facts"],startup="startup_stm32unknown.s")
    elif change in {"USBX","class","RTOS"}:
        ioc=next(root.glob("*.ioc")); data=ioc.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        if change=="USBX": data=data.replace("=USB_DEVICE","=USBX")
        elif change=="class": data=data.replace("=Cdc","=Hid")
        else: data+="\nMcu.IP99=FREERTOS\n"
        ioc.write_text(data,encoding="utf-8")
    elif change in {"dynamic-allocation","unknown-hook"}:
        path=root/("USB_DEVICE/Target/usbd_conf.c" if change=="dynamic-allocation" else "USB_DEVICE/App/usbd_cdc_if.c")
        data=path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        path.write_text(data.replace("USBD_static_malloc","malloc") if change=="dynamic-allocation" else data.replace("USER CODE BEGIN 6","UNKNOWN HOOK"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="spi-owner":
        path=root/"Core/Src/spi.c"; path.write_text(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").replace("SPI_MODE_MASTER","SPI_MODE_SLAVE"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="tick":
        for path in (root/"Core/Src").glob("*.c"):
            data=path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            if "HAL_IncTick" in data: path.write_text(data.replace("HAL_IncTick","Unknown_Tick"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="include-escape": make.write_text(text.replace("-ICore/Inc","-I../escape"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="make-append": make.write_text(text+"\nC_SOURCES += Core/Src/extra.c\n",encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="memory-expression":
        script=next(root.glob("*.ld"))
        script.write_text(script.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").replace("MEMORY\n{", "MEMORY\n{\nEXTRA (xrw) : ORIGIN = (0x40000000), LENGTH = 1K"),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change in {"spi-unknown-abi","spi-mixed-qualifier"}:
        header=next((root/"Drivers").glob("*_HAL_Driver/Inc/*_hal_spi.h"))
        data=header.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        data=data.replace("const uint8_t *pData", "uint32_t *pData" if change=="spi-unknown-abi" else "uint8_t *pData",1)
        header.write_text(data,encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="reset-owner":
        startup=root/args["device_facts"].startup
        startup.write_text(startup.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").replace("Reset_Handler:",
            ".thumb_set Reset_Handler, Default_Handler\nSyntheticReset:",1),encoding="utf-8")
    elif change=="facts-fpu":
        args["device_facts"]=replace(args["device_facts"],fpu="" if args["device_facts"].fpu else "fpv4-sp-d16")
    else:
        script=next(root.glob("*.ld")); script.write_text(script.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")+"\nINCLUDE other.ld\n",encoding="utf-8")
    reasons={"make-append":"literal C_SOURCES", "memory-expression":"Linker memory",
        "reset-owner":"reset entry body/owner", "facts-fpu":"FPU facts",
        "spi-unknown-abi":"blocking SPI ABI", "spi-mixed-qualifier":"SPI transmit buffer qualifiers",
        "missing-cdc":"Missing or escaping", "make-expression":"expression", "CPU":"Native CPU",
        "ABI":"ABI|FLOAT-ABI", "memory":"Linker memory", "device-macro":"effective definitions",
        "startup":"startup", "USBX":"Only complete", "class":"Only complete", "RTOS":"FreeRTOS",
        "dynamic-allocation":"Dynamic native USB", "unknown-hook":"lifecycle/receive hook",
        "spi-owner":"real type/init owner", "tick":"tick initialization", "include-escape":"Unsafe native build path",
        "linker-dependency":"linker file dependencies"}
    with pytest.raises(CubeMxImportError,match=reasons[change]): NativeClassicCdc_Inspect(root,**args)

"""Profile admission and patch replay; no EP0 behavior/review is exercised."""
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from dataclasses import replace
import difflib
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import pytest
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import NativeC_FunctionSpanGet
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_usb_data import NativeUsbBulk_FilesRender, NativeUsbData_Derive, NativeUsbCore_Derive, NativeUsbLl_Derive
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_radio import NativeRadioHal_Derive, NativeRadioDevice_Derive

@pytest.fixture
def ground_native(tmp_path):
    return native.__wrapped__(SimpleNamespace(param='f103-usb'), tmp_path)


def _Replay(tmp_path, path, original, derived, patch):
    git = shutil.which('git')
    if git is None: pytest.fail('Git required for exact patch replay')
    dest = tmp_path/path; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); dest.write_bytes(original)
    run = subprocess.run([git,'-c','core.autocrlf=false','-c','core.eol=lf',
        'apply','--no-index','-p0','-'],input=patch,cwd=tmp_path,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
    assert run.returncode == 0, run.stdout.decode(errors='replace')+run.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
    assert dest.read_bytes() == derived


def test_native_usb_profiles_patch_replay_and_ep0_identity(ground_native, tmp_path):
    root,args = ground_native
    proof,_inventory,files = NativeClassicCdc_Inspect(root,**args)
    rendered,_replacements,manifest = NativeUsbBulk_FilesRender(files,proof['cdc']['owners'])
    for entry in manifest['entries']:
        original = files[entry['original'].removeprefix('HardwareGenerated/NativeClassicCdc/')]
        _Replay(tmp_path,entry['original'],original,rendered[entry['derived']],rendered[entry['patch']])
    original = files[proof['cdc']['owners']['usbd_cdc.c']].decode('utf-8-sig')
    derived = NativeUsbData_Derive(original.encode()).decode()
    for name in ('USBD_CDC_Setup','USBD_CDC_EP0_RxReady'):
        a,_o,b = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(original,name)
        c,_o,d = NativeC_FunctionSpanGet(derived,name)
        assert original[a:b] == derived[c:d]

def test_radio_same_path_patch_reproduces_owned_derivative(tmp_path,kind):
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'plugins/builtin/silverstar_device_telemetry_sx1281/payload'
    path,derive = ('Middlewares/Third_Party/SX1280lib/sx1280-hal.c',NativeRadioHal_Derive) if kind=='hal' else (
        'Devices/Telemetry/SX1281/Src/sx1281_device.c',NativeRadioDevice_Derive)

    patch = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),

@pytest.mark.parametrize('mutation',['normal','gpio-missing','gpio-after-owner','spi-after-owner','gpio-duplicate'])
def test_native_main_gpio_spi_order_is_required_before_runtime(ground_native,mutation):
    root,args = ground_native
    proof,inventory,files = NativeClassicCdc_Inspect(root,**args)
    path = proof['cdc']['owners']['main.c']
    if mutation == 'gpio-missing': files[path] = files[path].replace(b'  MX_GPIO_Init();',b'')
    elif mutation == 'gpio-after-owner':
        files[path] = files[path].replace(b'  MX_GPIO_Init();',b'').replace(
            b'/* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */',b'/* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */\n  MX_GPIO_Init();')
    elif mutation == 'spi-after-owner':
        files[path] = files[path].replace(b'  MX_SPI1_Init();',b'').replace(
            b'/* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */',b'/* USER CODE BEGIN 2 */\n  MX_SPI1_Init();')
    elif mutation == 'gpio-duplicate':
        files[path] = files[path].replace(b'  MX_GPIO_Init();',b'  MX_GPIO_Init();\n  MX_GPIO_Init();')
    scg = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    catalog = PluginCatalog(scg/'plugins/builtin',scg/'plugins/installed'); catalog.Scan()
    model = _GroundBoardProject_Get(catalog)
    model.ground_target = replace(model.ground_target,pc_interface='usb_cdc',activity_led_enabled=False,
        tx_led_resource='',rx_led_resource='')
    model.air_link = replace(model.air_link,radio_family='sx128x')
    if mutation == 'normal':
        rendered,_graph,_contract = NativeGroundCandidate_Render(files,proof,inventory,model,catalog,hclk_hz=72000000)
        assert b'NativePlatform_Quiesce();' in rendered['Generated/Src/native_runtime.c']
    else:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='GPIO and SPI initialization'):
            NativeGroundCandidate_Render(files,proof,inventory,model,catalog,hclk_hz=72000000)

"""Normal backend import/model/render/build flow; no USB packet/owner research."""
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

import shutil
import pytest

from test_native_classic_cdc import native
from silverstar_fccg.app.service import FccgService

@pytest.fixture

    result = service.NativeClassicCdcGroundProject_Import(root, model, **args,

    assert result.result == NativeGroundBackendResult.ImportedCandidate
    return service, result, args, root


def test_backend_import_save_reload_render_normal_flow(bound, tmp_path_factory):
    service, imported, args, original_root = bound
    model = imported.model
    before = {p.relative_to(original_root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              for p in original_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    project = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('p')
    service.ProjectRoot_Save(model, project, create_new=True)
    loaded = ProjectModel_Load(project / 'SilverStar.ssproject')
    assert loaded.Dictionary_Get() == model.Dictionary_Get()
    assert loaded.ground_target.mcu == loaded.ground_target.board == ''
    assert loaded.ground_target.resource_assignments['radio0:spi'] == 'SPI1'
    assert loaded.ground_target.hardware.inventory[BINDING_KEY]['facts_sha256']
    # Reload in another service instance with the same backend cache, not CLI args.
    reloaded = FccgService(service.workspace_root)
    reloaded.catalog = service.catalog
    plan = reloaded.NativeClassicCdcGroundCandidate_Plan(loaded, device_facts=args['device_facts'])
    assert plan.profile == imported.profile
    assert plan.snapshot_id == imported.imported.hardware.snapshot_id
    assert 'NativeRuntime_Init' in plan.files['Generated/Src/native_runtime.c'].decode()
    assert plan.contract['publication'].startswith('PRIVATE CANDIDATE ONLY')
    assert 'NOT PROVEN' in plan.contract['ep0_review']
    output = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('o') / 'r'
    result = reloaded.NativeClassicCdcGroundCandidate_Export(loaded, output, device_facts=args['device_facts'])
    assert result.result == NativeGroundBackendResult.RenderedCandidate
    receipt = json.loads(result.receipt.read_text())
    assert receipt['status'] == 'RENDERED_NOT_COMPILED'
    assert receipt['model_sha256'] == plan.model_sha256
    assert receipt['files_sha256'] == {p: hashlib.sha256((output / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in plan.files}
    assert result.receipt_sha256 == hashlib.sha256(result.receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert before == {p.relative_to(original_root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                      for p in original_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert not any((project / 'Ground_Station').iterdir())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Normal firmware generation is blocked'):
        GroundFiles_Render(loaded, service.catalog, service.policy)


def test_formal_build_rejects_even_without_ensure_buildable(bound, tmp_path_factory, monkeypatch):

    with pytest.raises(FccgError, match='formal build remains blocked'):
        service.Build_Run(imported.model, tmp_path_factory.mktemp('p'), BuildAction.BUILD,
            ensure_buildable=False)

def test_bound_project_mismatch_rejected_before_output(bound, tmp_path_factory, change):
    service, imported, args, _root = bound
    model = deepcopy(imported.model)
    facts = args['device_facts']

        facts = replace(facts, evidence_sha256='0' * 64)
    elif change == 'profile':
        model.ground_target.hardware.inventory[BINDING_KEY]['profile'] = 'generic-stm32'
    elif change == 'source-graph':
        model.ground_target = replace(model.ground_target,
            hardware=replace(model.ground_target.hardware, build_sources=()))
    elif change == 'resource':
        model.ground_target = replace(model.ground_target, resource_assignments={'radio0:spi': 'SPI2'})
    elif change == 'clock':
        model.ground_target.hardware.inventory[BINDING_KEY]['hclk_hz'] = 1
    else:
        model.ground_target.hardware.inventory[BINDING_KEY]['formal_generation'] = 'ENABLED'
    output = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('o') / 'r'
    with pytest.raises(CubeMxImportError):
        service.NativeClassicCdcGroundCandidate_Export(model, output, device_facts=facts)
    assert not output.exists()

def test_existing_output_and_unsaved_project_not_overwritten(bound, tmp_path_factory):
    service, imported, args, _root = bound
    project = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('p')
    service.ProjectRoot_Save(imported.model, project, create_new=True)
    output = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('o')
    (output / 'user.txt').write_text('retain me')
    with pytest.raises(CubeMxImportError, match='new unaliased output'):
        service.NativeClassicCdcGroundCandidate_Export(imported.model, output, device_facts=args['device_facts'])
    assert (output / 'user.txt').read_text() == 'retain me'
    unsaved = deepcopy(imported.model)

    fresh = tmp_path_factory.mktemp('o') / 'b'

def test_real_arm_cpu_override_object_rejected(tmp_path):
    compiler=shutil.which('arm-none-eabi-gcc'); readelf=shutil.which('arm-none-eabi-readelf')
    if not compiler or not readelf:pytest.skip('real ARM tools unavailable')
    source=tmp_path/'override.s';obj=tmp_path/'override.o'

    compiled=subprocess.run([compiler,'-mcpu=cortex-m3','-mthumb','-mfloat-abi=soft','-c',str(source),'-o',str(obj)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
    assert compiled.returncode==0,compiled.stdout+compiled.stderr

    assert attributes.returncode==0 and 'v7E-M' in attributes.stdout

        NativeArmAttributes_Validate(attributes.stdout,core='cortex-m3',fpu='',hard_float=False,assembly=True)


def test_binary_vector_exchange_rejected_independently():
    import struct
    symbols='08000100 T USB_HP_CAN1_TX_IRQHandler\n08000200 T USB_LP_CAN1_RX0_IRQHandler\n'
    vector=bytearray(37*4)
    struct.pack_into('<I',vector,35*4,0x08000101)
    struct.pack_into('<I',vector,36*4,0x08000201)
    slots={'USB_HP_CAN1_TX_IRQHandler':19,'USB_LP_CAN1_RX0_IRQHandler':20}
    NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector,symbols,slots)
    vector[35*4:37*4]=vector[36*4:37*4]+vector[35*4:36*4]

        NativeIndependentVectors_Validate(vector,symbols,slots)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import sys
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox

from silverstar_fccg.app.version import PRODUCT_NAME, __version__
from silverstar_fccg.app.service import FccgService
from silverstar_fccg.core.settings import SettingsStore
from silverstar_fccg.core.i18n import Translator
from silverstar_fccg.ui.main_window import MainWindow
from silverstar_fccg.ui.message_box import MessageBoxButtons_Localize


def WorkspaceRoot_Get() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


def _Arguments_Parse(arguments: list[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="SilverStar System Configuration & Generation (SCG)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--lang", choices=("zh_CN", "en_US"))
    parser.add_argument("--theme", choices=("light", "dark"))
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version=__version__)
    return parser.parse_args(arguments)


def _Logging_Configure(workspace_root: Path) -> Path:
    log_directory = workspace_root / ".fccg" / "logs"
    log_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_path = log_directory / "silverstar_fccg.log"
    handler = RotatingFileHandler(
        log_path,
        maxBytes=2_000_000,
        backupCount=3,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    handler.setFormatter(
        logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
    )
    root_logger = logging.getLogger()
    root_logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    root_logger.addHandler(handler)
    return log_path


def main(arguments: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    options = _Arguments_Parse(list(arguments) if arguments is not None else sys.argv[1:])
    application = QApplication([sys.argv[0]])
    application.setOrganizationName("SilverStar")
    application.setApplicationName(PRODUCT_NAME)
    application.setApplicationVersion(__version__)
    application.setAttribute(Qt.ApplicationAttribute.AA_DontUseNativeMenuBar, False)
    workspace_root = WorkspaceRoot_Get()
    log_path = _Logging_Configure(workspace_root)
    settings = SettingsStore(workspace_root / ".fccg" / "settings.ini")
    language = options.lang or str(settings.Value_Get("language", "zh_CN"))
    theme = options.theme or str(settings.Value_Get("theme", "light"))
    translator = Translator(language)

    def exception_hook(exception_type, exception, exception_traceback) -> None:
        logging.critical(
            "Unhandled exception",
            exc_info=(exception_type, exception, exception_traceback),
        )
        box = QMessageBox()
        box.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Critical)
        box.setWindowTitle(PRODUCT_NAME)
        box.setText(translator.Text_Get("error.unhandled_exception"))
        box.setDetailedText(str(exception))
        box.setStandardButtons(QMessageBox.StandardButton.Ok)
        MessageBoxButtons_Localize(box, translator)
        box.exec()

    sys.excepthook = exception_hook
    try:
        service = FccgService(workspace_root)
        window = MainWindow(settings, service=service, language=language, theme=theme)
    except Exception:
        logging.exception("Application startup failed")
        exception_type, exception, exception_traceback = sys.exc_info()
        assert exception_type is not None and exception is not None
        exception_hook(exception_type, exception, exception_traceback)
        return 1
    window.show()
    logging.info("%s %s started; log=%s", PRODUCT_NAME, __version__, log_path)
    return int(application.exec())

def _Profile_Load(name):
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "hardware/usb_profiles" / name
    if (name not in _PROFILE_HASHES or path.is_symlink() or
            _Hash_Get(path.read_bytes()) != _PROFILE_HASHES[name]):
        raise CubeMxImportError("Backend USB target profile identity changed")
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def UsbGroundTarget_Validate(part: str, hclk_hz: int):
    expected = {"STM32F103C8T6": 72_000_000, C071_PART: 48_000_000}
    if part not in expected or type(hclk_hz) is not int or expected[part] != hclk_hz:
        raise CubeMxImportError("First-batch USB backend requires exact F103C8T6/72MHz or C071FBP6/48MHz; F407 remains a separate private candidate")


def UsbGroundDeviceFacts_Get(part: str, independent_irq_header: Path) -> NativeDeviceFacts:
    if part not in FIRST_BATCH_PARTS:
        raise CubeMxImportError("Unsupported first-batch exact USB target")
    values = _Profile_Load("f103-device-facts.json" if part == FIRST_BATCH_PARTS[0] else "c071-device-facts.json")
    facts = NativeDeviceFacts(**{**values,
        "regions": tuple(NativeMemoryRegion(**item) for item in values["regions"]),
        "irq_numbers": tuple(tuple(item) for item in values["irq_numbers"])})
    facts.Facts_Validate()
    path = Path(independent_irq_header)
    if path.is_symlink() or path.is_junction() or not path.is_file():
        raise CubeMxImportError("Independent SDK IRQ header unavailable")
    body = path.read_bytes()
    enumerators = tuple((name, int(value)) for name, value in
        re.findall(r"([A-Za-z0-9_]+_IRQn)\s*=\s*(-?\d+)", body.decode("utf-8-sig")))
    if _Hash_Get(body) != facts.irq_header_sha256 or enumerators != facts.irq_numbers:
        raise CubeMxImportError("Independent SDK IRQ bytes/enumerators differ from backend facts")
    return facts


def _IndependentHeader_Validate(header, root):
    if Path(header).resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
        raise CubeMxImportError("Independent SDK facts must be supplied outside the native input/cache")


def _Companion_Inspect(root):
    if root is None:
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 requires the pinned external companion source identity; no project capability flag can substitute")
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    expected = _Profile_Load("c071-companion-manifest.json")
    manifest = root / "companion-manifest.json"
    if _Hash_Get(manifest.read_bytes()) != _PROFILE_HASHES["c071-companion-manifest.json"]:
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 companion manifest identity changed")
    payload = root / "payload"
    actual = set()
    for path in payload.rglob("*"):
        if path.is_symlink() or path.is_junction() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(payload):
            raise CubeMxImportError("C071 companion payload alias rejected")
        if path.is_file():
            actual.add(path.relative_to(payload).as_posix())
    if actual != set(expected["files_sha256"]):
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 companion payload inventory changed")
    for relative, digest in expected["files_sha256"].items():
        if _Hash_Get((payload / relative).read_bytes()) != digest:
            raise CubeMxImportError("C071 companion payload identity changed: " + relative)
    # Byte identity is deliberately separate from review, ABI and runtime proof.
    return {"source_commit": "b66f142f7ab9b5611bd2f9a84a105835e4f77b96",
        "component": "silverstar.usb_cdc.stm32c071_mini", "version": "0.1.1",
        "manifest_sha256": _PROFILE_HASHES["c071-companion-manifest.json"],
        "files_sha256": expected["files_sha256"], "independent_review": "NO_PASSED_OUTCOME",
        "formal_release": False}


def _C071Native_Inspect(root):
    profile = _Profile_Load("c071-native-profile.json")
    iocs = tuple(root.glob("*.ioc"))
    if len(iocs) != 1:
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 requires one root IOC")
    expected = dict(profile["files_sha256"])
    expected.update({iocs[0].name: profile["ioc_sha256"], "Makefile": profile["makefile_sha256"],
        "startup_stm32c071xx.s": profile["startup_sha256"], "STM32C071XX_FLASH.ld": profile["linker_sha256"]})
    actual = set()
    for path in root.rglob("*"):
        relative = path.relative_to(root)
        if path.is_symlink() or path.is_junction() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
            raise CubeMxImportError("C071 native input alias rejected")
        if any(part.casefold() in {"build", ".git", "debug", "release"} for part in relative.parts):
            continue
        if path.is_file() and (relative.parts[0] in {"Core", "Drivers"} or
                path.suffix.lower() in {".c", ".h", ".s", ".ld", ".ioc"} or path.name == "Makefile"):
            actual.add(relative.as_posix())
    if actual != set(expected):
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 native complete source inventory changed")
    if sum((root / p).stat().st_size for p in expected) > 32 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 native snapshot exceeds fixed profile bound")
    files = {p: (root / p).read_bytes() for p in expected}
    if any(_Hash_Get(files[p]) != digest for p, digest in expected.items()):
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 native pin/clock/build/source identity changed")
    generated = {p: b.decode("utf-8-sig") for p, b in files.items() if p.startswith("Core/")}
    inventory = CubeMxInventory_Parse(files[iocs[0].name].decode("utf-8-sig"), generated_files=generated)
    return files, inventory, iocs[0].name, profile


def _C071Model_Validate(model, spi, gpio):
    radios = GroundRadioConfigurations_Get(model.ground_target)
    ground = model.ground_target
    if (not ground.enabled or ground.pc_interface != "usb_cdc" or
            model.air_link.radio_family != "sx128x" or len(radios) != 1 or
            radios[0].plugin != "silverstar.device.telemetry.sx1281" or
            radios[0].module_variant != "e28_2g4m12sx" or radios[0].instance_id != "radio0" or
            (spi, tuple(gpio)) != ("SPI1", ("RADIO_NSS", "RADIO_RESET", "RADIO_BUSY", "RADIO_DIO1")) or
            ground.tx_led_resource or ground.rx_led_resource or ground.activity_led_enabled is True):
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 model requires exact mini USB/single E28 resource profile; unrelated configurations are not silently replaced")


def _Snapshot_Store(importer, files, proof):
    encoded = _Json_Encode(proof)
    identity = _Hash_Get(encoded)
    parent = importer.policy.Path_Resolve(importer.cache_root / identity, allow_root=False)
    destination = parent / "UsbGroundNative"
    if os.name == "nt" and any(len(str(destination / p)) >= 248 for p in files):
        raise CubeMxImportError("Select a shorter workspace for portable native snapshot paths")
    if parent.exists():
        if not destination.is_dir() or (parent / "usb-ground-contract.json").read_bytes() != encoded:
            raise CubeMxImportError("Immutable C071 snapshot contract changed")
        cached, _inventory, _ioc, _profile = _C071Native_Inspect(destination)
        if cached != files:
            raise CubeMxImportError("Immutable C071 native snapshot changed")
    else:
        stage = importer.policy.StagingDirectory_Create("usb-ground-")
        try:
            for relative, body in files.items():
                importer.policy.RelativePath_Validate(relative)
                path = stage / "UsbGroundNative" / relative
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_bytes(body)
            (stage / "usb-ground-contract.json").write_bytes(encoded)
            parent.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            importer.policy.Path_Replace(stage, parent)
        finally:
            if stage.exists():
                importer.policy.Tree_Remove(stage)
    return identity, destination


def UsbGroundProject_Import(importer, catalog, input_path, model, *, part,
        independent_irq_header, hclk_hz, spi_resource, gpio_resources,
        risk_acknowledged, companion_root=None):
    UsbGroundTarget_Validate(part, hclk_hz)
    if risk_acknowledged is not True:
        raise CubeMxImportError("Explicit private USB candidate acknowledgement required")
    root, _ioc = importer._Input_Resolve(input_path)
    _IndependentHeader_Validate(independent_irq_header, root)
    facts = UsbGroundDeviceFacts_Get(part, independent_irq_header)
    if part == FIRST_BATCH_PARTS[0]:
        return NativeGroundProject_Import(importer, catalog, input_path, model,
            device_facts=facts, hclk_hz=hclk_hz, spi_resource=spi_resource,
            gpio_resources=gpio_resources, risk_acknowledged=True)
    _C071Model_Validate(model, spi_resource, gpio_resources)
    companion = _Companion_Inspect(companion_root)
    files, inventory, ioc, profile = _C071Native_Inspect(root)
    proof = {"part": part, "profile": C071_PROFILE, "hclk_hz": hclk_hz,
        "input_kind": "native_pcd_plus_pinned_classic_cdc", "native_cdc": False,
        "native_files_sha256": {p: _Hash_Get(b) for p, b in files.items()},
        "companion": companion, "native_profile_sha256": _PROFILE_HASHES["c071-native-profile.json"],
        "spi": spi_resource, "gpio": list(gpio_resources), "formal_generation": "BLOCKED"}
    identity, destination = _Snapshot_Store(importer, files, proof)
    candidate = deepcopy(model)
    binding = {"format_version": 3, "scope": "PRIVATE_USB_GROUND_C071_RUNTIME",
        "snapshot_id": identity, "profile": C071_PROFILE, "hclk_hz": hclk_hz,
        "formal_generation": "BLOCKED"}
    # No USB CDC runtime capability is granted from a PCD-only native project.
    native_build = profile["effective_build"]
    def paths(name):
        return tuple(C071_PREFIX + p.removeprefix("HardwareGenerated/STM32CubeMX/")
            for p in native_build[name] if p.startswith("HardwareGenerated/STM32CubeMX/"))
    hardware = HardwareConfiguration(mode="custom", source_kind="manual_import",
        provider="silverstar.hardware_provider.stm32_cubemx", snapshot_id=identity,
        ioc_file=ioc, mcu=part, cubemx_version=inventory.cubemx_version,
        firmware_package=inventory.firmware_package, hal_cmsis_source_policy="imported_tree_authoritative",
        capabilities=("usb.native_pcd",), inventory={**inventory.Dictionary_Get(), C071_KEY: proof, BINDING_KEY: binding},
        resources=tuple(HardwareResource(r.resource_id, r.kind, deepcopy(r.metadata)) for r in inventory.HardwareResources_Get()),
        build_sources=paths("build_sources"), asm_sources=paths("asm_sources"), include_dirs=paths("include_dirs"),
        defines=tuple(native_build["defines"]), linker_script=C071_PREFIX + "STM32C071XX_FLASH.ld",
        source_digest=identity, source_label=root.name, risk_acknowledged=True)
    candidate.ground_target = replace(candidate.ground_target, mcu="", board="", hardware=hardware,
        resource_assignments=_Resources_Get(candidate, spi_resource, tuple(gpio_resources)), pc_resource="")
    candidate = ProjectModel_Parse(candidate.Dictionary_Get())
    imported = CubeMxImportResult(hardware, destination, tuple(inventory.peripherals), (C071_LIMITS,), inventory)
    return NativeGroundProjectImportResult(NativeGroundBackendResult.ImportedCandidate, candidate, imported, C071_PROFILE)


def UsbGroundCandidate_Plan(importer, catalog, model, *, independent_irq_header, companion_root=None):
    hardware = model.ground_target.hardware
    part = hardware.mcu
    facts = UsbGroundDeviceFacts_Get(part, independent_irq_header)
    if part == FIRST_BATCH_PARTS[0]:
        snapshot = importer.cache_root / hardware.snapshot_id
        _IndependentHeader_Validate(independent_irq_header, snapshot)
        plan = NativeGroundCandidate_Plan(importer, catalog, model, device_facts=facts)
        return UsbGroundCandidatePlan(UsbGroundPlanResult.RenderedCandidate, part, plan.profile,
            plan.model_sha256, plan.snapshot_id,
            {"native_classic_cdc": True, "formal_release": False}, plan, {}, "F103 private candidate only; formal release BLOCKED")
    proof = hardware.inventory.get(C071_KEY)
    binding = hardware.inventory.get(BINDING_KEY)
    if not isinstance(proof, dict) or not isinstance(binding, dict):
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 binding missing; use unified import first")
    UsbGroundTarget_Validate(part, binding.get("hclk_hz"))
    identity = _Hash_Get(_Json_Encode(proof))
    if hardware.snapshot_id != identity or hardware.source_digest != identity:
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 model source binding changed")
    snapshot = importer.policy.Path_Resolve(importer.cache_root / identity / "UsbGroundNative", allow_root=False)
    _IndependentHeader_Validate(independent_irq_header, snapshot)
    result = UsbGroundProject_Import(importer, catalog, snapshot, model, part=part,
        independent_irq_header=independent_irq_header, hclk_hz=binding["hclk_hz"],
        spi_resource=proof.get("spi"), gpio_resources=tuple(proof.get("gpio", ())),
        risk_acknowledged=True, companion_root=companion_root)
    # source_label records the original display name, not capability authority.
    expected = result.model.Dictionary_Get()
    expected["ground_target"]["hardware"]["source_label"] = hardware.source_label
    if _Json_Encode(expected) != _Json_Encode(model.Dictionary_Get()):
        raise CubeMxImportError("C071 saved model/source/resource/capability binding changed; reimport phase-1 models")
    profile = _Profile_Load("c071-native-profile.json")
    from silverstar_fccg.generator.c071_candidate import C071Candidate_Render
    native, inventory, _ioc, _profile = _C071Native_Inspect(snapshot)
    files, graph, records = C071Candidate_Render(native, inventory, model, catalog, snapshot, profile)
    native_plan=NativeGroundCandidatePlan(_Hash_Get(_Json_Encode(model.Dictionary_Get())),
        identity,C071_PROFILE,files,graph,records)
    return UsbGroundCandidatePlan(UsbGroundPlanResult.RenderedCandidate, part, C071_PROFILE,
        native_plan.model_sha256, identity,
        {"native_pcd": True, "native_classic_cdc": False, "companion_source_identity_verified": True,
         "cdc_runtime_accepted": False, "formal_release": False}, native_plan,
        {"effective_build_to_integrate": profile["effective_build"], "companion": proof["companion"],
         "firmware_files_rendered": True, "native_hal_cmsis_startup_linker_pcd_ownership": "PRESERVED"}, C071_LIMITS)



def UsbGroundCandidate_Export(importer, catalog, model, output, *, independent_irq_header, companion_root=None):
    plan = UsbGroundCandidate_Plan(importer, catalog, model,
        independent_irq_header=independent_irq_header, companion_root=companion_root)
    if plan.result != UsbGroundPlanResult.RenderedCandidate:
        raise CubeMxImportError(plan.detail)
    if plan.part == C071_PART:
        destination=_Output_Validate(importer,model,output)
        from silverstar_fccg.core.workspace import WorkspacePolicy
        policy=WorkspacePolicy(destination)
        for path in plan.native_plan.files:
            policy.RelativePath_Validate(path)
            if os.name == 'nt' and len(str(destination/path)) >= 248:
                raise CubeMxImportError('Select a shorter candidate output path')
        destination.mkdir(parents=True)
        try:
            for path,body in plan.native_plan.files.items(): policy.Bytes_AtomicWrite(path,body)
            checked=UsbGroundCandidate_Plan(importer,catalog,model,independent_irq_header=independent_irq_header,companion_root=companion_root)
            if checked.model_sha256 != plan.model_sha256:
                raise CubeMxImportError('C071 model changed during private export')
            receipt=_Receipt_Write(destination,{'status':'RENDERED_NOT_COMPILED', 'scope':'PRIVATE_C071_GROUND_BACKEND',
                'model_sha256':plan.model_sha256,'snapshot_id':plan.source_snapshot_id,
                'files_sha256':{p:_Hash_Get(b) for p,b in plan.native_plan.files.items()},'limits':C071_LIMITS})
        except Exception as error:
            _Receipt_Write(destination,{'status':'FAILED_RENDER','failure':str(error),'limits':C071_LIMITS})
            raise
        return NativeGroundCandidateOutputResult(NativeGroundBackendResult.RenderedCandidate,destination,receipt,_Hash_Get(receipt.read_bytes()),C071_LIMITS)
    facts = UsbGroundDeviceFacts_Get(plan.part, independent_irq_header)
    return NativeGroundCandidate_Export(importer, catalog, model, output, device_facts=facts)


def UsbGroundCandidate_Build(importer, catalog, model, project_root, output, *, independent_irq_header, companion_root=None):
    plan = UsbGroundCandidate_Plan(importer, catalog, model,
        independent_irq_header=independent_irq_header, companion_root=companion_root)
    if plan.result != UsbGroundPlanResult.RenderedCandidate:
        raise CubeMxImportError(plan.detail)
    if plan.part == C071_PART:
        return _C071Candidate_Build(importer,catalog,model,project_root,output,plan,
            independent_irq_header=independent_irq_header,companion_root=companion_root)
    facts = UsbGroundDeviceFacts_Get(plan.part, independent_irq_header)
    return NativeGroundCandidate_Build(importer, catalog, model, project_root, output, device_facts=facts)


def _C071Candidate_Build(importer,catalog,model,project_root,output,plan,*,independent_irq_header,companion_root):
    from silverstar_fccg.project.model import ProjectModel_Load
    from silverstar_fccg.build.native_compile import NativeCompile_Run
    from silverstar_fccg.hardware.cubemx_ground import GroundCubeInputs_Get
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    import secrets
    project_root=Path(project_root)
    saved=ProjectModel_Load(project_root/'SilverStar.ssproject')
    if _Json_Encode(saved.Dictionary_Get()) != _Json_Encode(model.Dictionary_Get()):
        raise CubeMxImportError('Save the exact bound C071 model before private build')
    destination=_Output_Validate(importer,saved,output,project_root)
    for path in plan.native_plan.files:
        if os.name == 'nt' and len(str(destination/path)) >= 248:
            raise CubeMxImportError('Select a shorter candidate output path')
    snapshot=importer.cache_root/plan.source_snapshot_id/'UsbGroundNative'
    native,inventory,_ioc,_profile=_C071Native_Inspect(snapshot)
    facts=UsbGroundDeviceFacts_Get(C071_PART,independent_irq_header)
    inputs=GroundCubeInputs_Get(snapshot,C071_PART)
    irqs=dict(facts.irq_numbers)
    slots={handler:irqs['SysTick_IRQn' if handler=='SysTick_Handler' else handler.removesuffix('_IRQHandler')+'_IRQn']
        for handler in inputs.irq_handlers}
    g=plan.native_plan.graph
    proof={'build':{'sources':[], 'asm_sources':[], 'include_dirs':[], 'defines':g['defines'],
        'mcu_flags':g['mcu_flags'],'linker_script':'STM32C071XX_FLASH.ld'},
        'required_irq_handlers':g['required_irq_handlers'], 'independent_irq_slots':slots,
        'spi_abi':{'tx_buffer_const':True},'gpio_abi':{'read_port_const':True},'scope':'PRIVATE_C071_GROUND_RUNTIME_CANDIDATE'}
    token=secrets.token_hex(16)
    args=SimpleNamespace(input=snapshot,output=destination,spi='SPI1',gpio=[],clock_hz=48_000_000,
        runtime_project=project_root/'SilverStar.ssproject', toolchain_prefix=saved.ground_target.build.toolchain_prefix,
        reviewed_hal=False,native_timer_probe=False,backend_owner_token=token)
    failure=None
    try:
        receipt=NativeCompile_Run(args,device_facts=facts,runtime_catalog=catalog,
            prepared_candidate=(proof,inventory,native,dict(plan.native_plan.files),deepcopy(g),deepcopy(plan.native_plan.contract)))
        if receipt['status'] != 'NATIVE_SOURCE_CPP_GAS_ARM_LINK_AND_ANALYZER_EXECUTED' or receipt['runtime_model_sha256'] != plan.model_sha256:
            raise CubeMxImportError('C071 shared compiler did not prove the exact saved model')
        UsbGroundCandidate_Plan(importer,catalog,saved,independent_irq_header=independent_irq_header,companion_root=companion_root)
        if _Json_Encode(ProjectModel_Load(args.runtime_project).Dictionary_Get()) != _Json_Encode(saved.Dictionary_Get()):
            raise CubeMxImportError('Saved C071 model changed during build')
        result=NativeGroundBackendResult.CompiledCandidate
    except Exception as error:
        failure=str(error);result=NativeGroundBackendResult.FailedCandidate
        owner=destination/'backend-owner.json'
        if not owner.is_file() or json.loads(owner.read_text())['token'] != token: raise
    compilation=destination/'receipt.json'
    receipt=_Receipt_Write(destination,{'status':result.value,'scope':'PRIVATE_C071_GROUND_BACKEND',
        'model_sha256':plan.model_sha256,'snapshot_id':plan.source_snapshot_id,
        'compile_receipt_sha256':_Hash_Get(compilation.read_bytes()) if compilation.is_file() else None,
        'failure':failure,'limits':C071_LIMITS})
    return NativeGroundCandidateOutputResult(result,destination,receipt,_Hash_Get(receipt.read_bytes()),failure or C071_LIMITS)

"""Authoritative SilverStar platform and FCCG product identity."""

from pathlib import Path

PRODUCT_NAME = "SilverStar SCG"
SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION = (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="ascii").strip()

_VERSION_PARTS = tuple(
    int(part) for part in SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION.split(".")
)
if len(_VERSION_PARTS) != 3:
    raise RuntimeError("SilverStar platform version must have three numeric parts")

SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_MAJOR = _VERSION_PARTS[0]
SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_MINOR = _VERSION_PARTS[1]
SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_PATCH = _VERSION_PARTS[2]
SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_ID_SUFFIX = SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION.replace(".", "_")
SILVERSTAR_BUILD_ID = f"SilverStar_{SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_ID_SUFFIX}"
# The installed core plugin has its own schema/payload version.
SILVERSTAR_CORE_COMPONENT_ID = "silverstar.core.0_1_0"
SILVERSTAR_CORE_PACKAGE_SLUG = SILVERSTAR_CORE_COMPONENT_ID.replace(".", "_")
SILVERSTAR_LOG_BUILD_TAG = (
    "SILV"
    f"{SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_MAJOR}"
    f"{SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_MINOR}"
    f"{SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_PATCH:02d}"
)
# Profile identity is a wire compatibility value, independent of the product release.
SILVERSTAR_SYSTEM_PROFILE_ID = 0x0000000C

__version__ = SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION

__all__ = [
    "PRODUCT_NAME",
    "SILVERSTAR_BUILD_ID",
    "SILVERSTAR_CORE_COMPONENT_ID",
    "SILVERSTAR_CORE_PACKAGE_SLUG",
    "SILVERSTAR_LOG_BUILD_TAG",
    "SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_ID_SUFFIX",
    "SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION",
    "SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_MAJOR",
    "SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_MINOR",
    "SILVERSTAR_PLATFORM_VERSION_PATCH",
    "SILVERSTAR_SYSTEM_PROFILE_ID",
    "__version__",
]

"""Run explicitly selected generated targets independently, with real events."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from silverstar_fccg.build.runner import BuildAction, BuildResult, BuildRunner
from silverstar_fccg.core.task import TaskCancelledError
from silverstar_fccg.core.workspace import WorkspacePolicy
from silverstar_fccg.project.model import ProjectModel
from silverstar_fccg.project.power10_report import Power10TextPassed_Is
from silverstar_fccg.project.quality_inputs import QualityInputHash_Get


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TargetQualityResult:
    target: str
    root: Path
    model: ProjectModel
    result: BuildResult | None
    input_sha256: str
    duration: float
    error: str = ""

    @property
    def succeeded(self) -> bool:
        return bool(not self.error and self.result and self.result.succeeded and
                    (self.result.action != BuildAction.POWER10_CHECK or
                     Power10TextPassed_Is(self.result.output, self.result.return_code)))


@dataclass
class QualityBatchResult:
    targets: tuple[TargetQualityResult, ...]
    evidence_saved: bool = True

    @property
    def succeeded(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.targets) and self.evidence_saved and all(target.succeeded for target in self.targets)


def QualityBatch_Run(inputs: tuple[tuple[str, Path, ProjectModel], ...], action: BuildAction,
                     context) -> QualityBatchResult:
    outcomes = []

    def emit(target: str, kind: str, **values) -> None:
        context.Line_Report("FCCG_QUALITY|" + json.dumps(dict(target=target, kind=kind, **values)))

    for index, (target, root, model) in enumerate(inputs):
        context.Cancel_RaiseIfRequested()
        start = time.perf_counter()
        runner = BuildRunner(WorkspacePolicy(root))
        command = runner.Command_Get(model, action)
        result = None
        digest = ""
        error = ""
        emit(target, "begin", action=action.value)
        try:
            before = QualityInputHash_Get(root, target, action.value, command, include_artifacts=False)

            def progress(value) -> None:
                # PLAN / unknown phases stay indeterminate, not a timed percentage.
                known = value.stage not in {"PLAN", "TASK", "UNMEASURED", "NO_WORK"}
                fraction = (value.completed_steps / value.total_steps
                            if known and value.total_steps else None)
                emit(target, "progress", fraction=fraction, stage=value.stage,
                     current=value.stage_completed, total=value.stage_total, subject=value.subject)
                if fraction is not None:
                    context.Progress_Report(min(0.99, (index + fraction) / len(inputs)), "status.build_running")

            result = runner.Run(model, root, action, context,
                line_callback=lambda line: emit(target, "line", line=line),
                progress_callback=progress, target_kind=target)
            context.Cancel_RaiseIfRequested()
            after = QualityInputHash_Get(root, target, action.value, command, include_artifacts=False)
            if before != after:
                error = "Generated inputs changed during this check; result is NOT PROVEN"
            else:
                digest = QualityInputHash_Get(root, target, action.value, command)
        except TaskCancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception as exception:
            error = str(exception)
        outcome = TargetQualityResult(target, root, model, result, digest,
                                      time.perf_counter() - start, error)
        outcomes.append(outcome)
        emit(target, "done", succeeded=outcome.succeeded, error=error)
        context.Progress_Report(min(0.99, (index + 1) / len(inputs)), "status.build_running")
    return QualityBatchResult(tuple(outcomes))

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any


class FccgError(ValueError):
    """Stable user-facing error code plus non-translated technical diagnostics."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        code: str,
        params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        technical_detail: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        if not code.startswith("error."):
            technical_detail = technical_detail or code
            class_name = type(self).__name__.removesuffix("Error")
            code = "error." + re.sub(
                r"(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])", "_", class_name
            ).casefold()
        self.code = code
        self.params = dict(params or {})
        self.technical_detail = technical_detail or code
        super().__init__(self.technical_detail)

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.technical_detail

from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import replace
import hashlib, json
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.c071_mini import C071Native_Validate, C071PadIdentity_Get
from silverstar_fccg.hardware.cubemx_ground import GroundCubeInputs_Get
from silverstar_fccg.generator.c071_recipe import C071Recipe_Render
from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_no_heap import NativeNoHeap_FilesRender

def C071Candidate_Render(native, inventory, model, catalog, snapshot, profile):
    inputs=GroundCubeInputs_Get(snapshot, 'STM32C071FBP6')
    companion=C071Native_Validate(snapshot)
    from silverstar_fccg.project.model import HardwareResource
    resources=inventory.HardwareResources_Get()+(HardwareResource('USB_CDC','usb_cdc',{
        'capabilities':['usb.device','usb.cdc'],
        'physical_resource':'C071 USB Device classic CDC companion',
        'pins':{'dm':'PA11','dp':'PA12'},'interrupt':'USB_DRD_FS_IRQn',
        'source_kind':'registered_companion','companion_profile':companion['profile'],'native_cdc':False}),)
    data=inventory.Dictionary_Get()
    data.update(ground_cubemx_base={'format_version':1,'mcu_flags':list(inputs.flags),
        'required_irq_handlers':list(inputs.irq_handlers), 'build_manifest':'Makefile',
        'artifact_hashes':{p:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p,b in native.items()}},
        native_usb_cdc=data['usb_cdc'],usb_cdc=True,c071_companion=companion,
        package_pad_identity=C071PadIdentity_Get(native[model.ground_target.hardware.ioc_file].decode('utf8')))
    build=profile['effective_build']
    hardware=replace(model.ground_target.hardware, inventory=data, resources=resources,
        capabilities=tuple(sorted({'peripheral.'+r.kind for r in resources})),
        build_sources=tuple(build['build_sources']),include_dirs=tuple(build['include_dirs']),
        asm_sources=tuple(build['asm_sources']),defines=tuple(build['defines']),linker_script=build['linker_script'])
    internal=deepcopy(model)
    roles={'radio_bus':'SPI1','radio_nss':'RADIO_NSS','radio_reset':'RADIO_RESET',
        'radio_busy':'RADIO_BUSY','radio_dio1':'RADIO_DIO1','time':'SYSTEM_TIME'}
    internal.ground_target=replace(internal.ground_target,mcu='silverstar.mcu.stm32c071fbp6',
        hardware=hardware,pc_resource='USB_CDC',resource_assignments={'radio0:'+k:v for k,v in roles.items()})
    files=C071Recipe_Render(internal,catalog,native)
    files.update(NativeNoHeap_FilesRender(native['Core/Src/sysmem.c']))
    from pathlib import Path
    files['Tools/native_machine_contract.py']=(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'hardware/native_machine_contract.py').read_bytes()
    graph=json.loads(files['Generated/ground_source_graph.json'])
    graph['sources'].append('Generated/Src/native_no_heap.c')
    # Reuse the existing bare-metal single radio owner repair. DIO ISR only
    # records a flag; tick and USB must remain live during radio SPI/Busy waits.
    from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_radio import NativeRadioHal_Derive,NativeRadioDevice_Derive
    import difflib
    payload_derivatives=[]
    radio_hal='Devices/Telemetry/SX1281/Hal/sx1280-hal.c'
    candidates=[p for p in files if p.endswith('/sx1280-hal.c')]
    if len(candidates)!=1:raise ValueError('C071 radio HAL owner is not unique')
    radio_hal=candidates[0]
    for original,derived,transform in (
        (radio_hal,'HardwareGenerated/ReviewedC071Radio/'+radio_hal,
         lambda body:NativeRadioHal_Derive(body,context_header='c071_context.h',context_expression='C071MainContext_AllowedGet()')),
        ('Devices/Telemetry/SX1281/Src/sx1281_device.c','Devices/Telemetry/SX1281/Src/sx1281_device.c',NativeRadioDevice_Derive)):
        body=files[original]
        target_body=transform(body)
        archived=original if original!=derived else 'HardwareGenerated/ReviewedC071Radio/Original/'+original
        files[archived]=body;files[derived]=target_body
        patch=derived+'.patch'
        files[patch]=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(body.decode().splitlines(True),target_body.decode().splitlines(True),fromfile=original,tofile=derived)).encode()
        graph['sources']=[derived if p==original else p for p in graph['sources']]
        payload_derivatives.append({'original':archived,'derived':derived,'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
            'derived_sha256':hashlib.sha256(target_body).hexdigest(),'patch':patch,'patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(files[patch]).hexdigest()})
    files['Generated/Inc/c071_context.h']=b'#ifndef C071_CONTEXT_H\n#define C071_CONTEXT_H\n#include <stdint.h>\nuint8_t C071MainContext_AllowedGet(void);\n#endif\n'
    files['Generated/Src/c071_context.c']=b'#include "c071_context.h"\n#include "main.h"\nuint8_t C071MainContext_AllowedGet(void) { return ((__get_IPSR() == 0U) && (__get_PRIMASK() == 0U)) ? 1U : 0U; }\n'
    graph['sources'].append('Generated/Src/c071_context.c')
    from silverstar_fccg.generator.native_hal import _SpiBounded_Apply,_UartPointer_Apply
    hal_derivatives=[]
    for name,transform in (
        ('stm32c0xx_hal_spi.c',_SpiBounded_Apply),
        ('stm32c0xx_hal_uart.c',lambda text:_UartPointer_Apply(text,functions=(('HAL_UART_Transmit','gState'),))),
        ('stm32c0xx_hal_uart_ex.c',lambda text:_UartPointer_Apply(text,functions=(('HAL_UARTEx_ReceiveToIdle','RxState'),)))):
        relative='Drivers/STM32C0xx_HAL_Driver/Src/'+name
        original='HardwareGenerated/STM32CubeMX/'+relative
        derived='HardwareGenerated/ReviewedC071Hal/'+relative
        body=native[relative]
        if hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()!=profile['files_sha256'][relative]:
            raise ValueError('C071 exact native HAL profile changed')
        text=transform(body.decode('utf8'))
        files[derived]=text.encode()
        patch=derived+'.patch'
        files[patch]=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(body.decode().splitlines(True),text.splitlines(True),fromfile=original,tofile=derived)).encode()
        graph['sources']=[derived if p==original else p for p in graph['sources']]
        hal_derivatives.append({'original':original,'derived':derived,'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
            'derived_sha256':hashlib.sha256(files[derived]).hexdigest(),'patch':patch,'patch_sha256':hashlib.sha256(files[patch]).hexdigest()})
    graph['native_hal_derivatives']=hal_derivatives
    graph['required_link_symbols']=['_sbrk']
    graph['formal_release']=False
    graph['independent_usb_review']='NO_PASSED_OUTCOME'
    records={'format_version':1,'scope':'PRIVATE_C071_GROUND_RUNTIME_CANDIDATE',
        'original_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() for p,b in native.items()},
        'payload_derivatives':payload_derivatives,'native_hal_derivatives':hal_derivatives,
        'compiled_owned_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(files[p]).hexdigest() for p in graph['sources']},
        'input_kind':'native_pcd_plus_pinned_classic_cdc','native_cdc':False,
        'no_heap':'Rejecting _sbrk ABI; static class block; original sysmem retained, uncompiled',
        'independent_usb_review':'NO_PASSED_OUTCOME','formal_release':False,
        'limits':'EP0/async lifecycle, manual critical contracts, stack/WCET and hardware NOT PROVEN'}
    files['Generated/ground_source_graph.json']=json.dumps(graph,indent=2).encode()
    files['Generated/native_ground_contract.json']=json.dumps(records,indent=2).encode()
    return files,graph,records

"""Private exact C071 ordinary recipe; no formal release or review assertion.

Recipe provenance b66f142; independent USB safety review has no passed outcome.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from silverstar_fccg.generator.multi_target import (
    AirLinkHeader_Render,
    DeviceInstance,
    GROUND_CORE_ID,
    GROUND_DIRECTORY,
    GroundEnvironmentFiles_Render,
    GroundRadioAirHeader_Render,
    GroundRadioConfig_Render,
    GroundRadioConfigurations_Get,
    GroundTargetIssues_Get,
    PluginCatalog,
    ProjectModel,
    SourceGraph_Resolve,
    _InstanceResourcesSource_Render,
    _Main_Integrate,
    _Makefile_Render,
    _PayloadFiles_Add,
    _PcAdapter_Render,
    _PlatformResources_Render,
    _ResourceHeader_Render,
    _UsbCallback_Integrate,
    _UsbConf_Integrate,
    _UserSection_Insert,
    _VerifiedBoardMain_Prepare,
    __version__,
    json,
    replace
)

def _GroundModel_Get(model: ProjectModel, catalog: PluginCatalog) -> ProjectModel:
    ground = model.ground_target
    mcu_family = str(
        catalog.Component_Get(ground.mcu).metadata.get("platform_family_id", "")
    )
    if not mcu_family:
        raise ValueError("Ground exact MCU does not declare a family backend")
    return replace(
        model, core=GROUND_CORE_ID, mcu_family=mcu_family,
        mcu=ground.mcu, board=ground.board, os="",
        device_instances=[DeviceInstance(radio.instance_id, radio.plugin,
                          module_variant=radio.module_variant, tx_power_dbm=radio.tx_power_dbm)
                          for radio in GroundRadioConfigurations_Get(ground)],
        base_components=(["silverstar.usb_cdc.stm32c071_mini"]
                         if ground.hardware.mcu == "STM32C071FBP6" else []), strategies={}, modes={}, protocols={
            "telemetry": None, "maintenance": None, "logging": None,
        }, development_environment="", hardware=ground.hardware,
        resource_assignments=dict(ground.resource_assignments),
        capability_source_overrides={}, logging_streams=[],
        build=ground.build,
    )

def C071Recipe_Render(
    model: ProjectModel, catalog: PluginCatalog, native_files: dict[str, bytes],
) -> dict[str, bytes]:
    from silverstar_fccg.hardware.c071_mini import C071GroundModel_Validate
    C071GroundModel_Validate(model, catalog)
    issues = GroundTargetIssues_Get(model, catalog)
    if issues:
        raise ValueError("; ".join(f"{issue.code}: {issue.message}" for issue in issues))
    ground = model.ground_target
    ground_model = _GroundModel_Get(model, catalog)
    c071 = ground.hardware.mcu == "STM32C071FBP6"
    catalog = catalog.ProjectView_Get(ground_model)
    core = catalog.Component_Get(GROUND_CORE_ID)
    radio = catalog.Component_Get(ground.radio_plugin)
    mcu = catalog.Component_Get(ground.mcu)
    files: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    _PayloadFiles_Add(files, core)
    nrf24 = model.air_link.radio_family == "nrf24"
    backend_adapters = core.metadata.get("ground_radio_backends", {})
    if set(backend_adapters) != {"sx128x", "nrf24"}:
        raise ValueError("Ground core must declare both supported backend adapters")
    for path in backend_adapters.values():
        if not isinstance(path, str) or not path.startswith("Ground/Radio/Src/") or ".." in path.split("/") or path not in files:
            raise ValueError("Ground backend adapter must be an owned declared payload")
    radio_adapter = backend_adapters[model.air_link.radio_family]
    for backend, path in backend_adapters.items():
        if backend != model.air_link.radio_family:
            files.pop(path)
    _PayloadFiles_Add(files, radio, skip_adapter=True)
    family = catalog.Component_Get(ground_model.mcu_family)
    platform_api = catalog.Component_Get("silverstar.platform.api")
    for owner in (platform_api, family, mcu):
        for source in owner.PayloadFiles_Get():
            relative = source.relative_to(owner.payload_root).as_posix()
            if (ground.hardware.hal_cmsis_source_policy == "imported_tree_authoritative"
                    and (relative.startswith(("Drivers/", "Middlewares/"))
                         or relative in {mcu.build.linker_script, *mcu.build.asm_sources})):
                continue
            if relative.startswith(("Middlewares/Third_Party/FatFs/", "FATFS/")):
                continue
            if relative.startswith(("Platform/", "Drivers/", "BuildSystem/", "Middlewares/")) or relative in {
                mcu.build.linker_script, *mcu.build.asm_sources,
            }:
                files[relative] = source.read_bytes()
    flight_core = catalog.Component_Get(model.core)
    for relative in (
        "Common/Inc/silverstar_assert.h", "Common/Inc/silverstar_compiler.h",
        "Common/Src/silverstar_assert.c", "Interfaces/Inc/system_device_types.h",
        "Tools/check_power_of_ten.ps1",
    ):
        files[relative] = (flight_core.payload_root / relative).read_bytes()
    if ground.hardware.mode == "board_plugin":
        board = catalog.Component_Get(ground.board)
        for source in board.PayloadFiles_Get():
            relative = source.relative_to(board.payload_root).as_posix()
            if not relative.startswith("FATFS/"):
                files[relative] = source.read_bytes()
    else:
        files.update({"HardwareGenerated/STM32CubeMX/"+p:b for p,b in native_files.items()})

    main_path = "Core/Src/main.c" if ground.hardware.mode == "board_plugin" else \
        "HardwareGenerated/STM32CubeMX/Core/Src/main.c"
    if main_path not in files:
        raise ValueError("Ground CubeMX hardware has no generated Core/Src/main.c")
    if ground.hardware.mode == "board_plugin":
        files[main_path] = _VerifiedBoardMain_Prepare(
            files[main_path], catalog.Component_Get(ground.board)
        )
    replacements = {}
    if c071:
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.ground_c071_usb import C071Files_Integrate
        replacements = C071Files_Integrate(files,
            catalog.Component_Get("silverstar.usb_cdc.stm32c071_mini"),
            _UserSection_Insert, _UsbConf_Integrate)
        main_path = replacements[main_path]
        path = "Ground/Core/Src/ground_bridge.c"
        bridge = files[path].decode()
        site = "    GroundRadio_Process();"
        if bridge.count(site) != 1:
            raise ValueError("unreviewed C071 bridge service site")
        files[path] = ('#include "pc_c071_usb.h"\n' +
            bridge.replace(site, "    PcC071Usb_Service();\n" + site)).encode()
    else:
        files[main_path] = _Main_Integrate(files[main_path], usb=ground.pc_interface == "usb_cdc")
    if ground.pc_interface == "usb_cdc" and not c071:
        callback_paths = [path for path in files if path.endswith("/usbd_cdc_if.c")]
        if len(callback_paths) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Ground CubeMX hardware has no unique usbd_cdc_if.c")
        original_callback = files[callback_paths[0]]
        files[callback_paths[0]] = _UsbCallback_Integrate(original_callback)
        from silverstar_fccg.generator.ground_usb_control import NativeControl_Integrate, NativeControl_Definitions_Validate
        replacements.update(NativeControl_Integrate(files, callback_paths[0], original_callback))
        conf_paths = [path for path in files if path.endswith("/usbd_conf.c")]
        if len(conf_paths) != 1:
            raise ValueError("Ground CubeMX hardware has no unique usbd_conf.c")
        files[conf_paths[0]] = _UsbConf_Integrate(files[conf_paths[0]])

    files["Generated/Inc/project_resources.h"] = _ResourceHeader_Render(
        ground_model, catalog
    ).encode("utf-8")
    files["Generated/Src/project_resources.c"] = _InstanceResourcesSource_Render(
        ground_model, catalog
    ).encode("utf-8")
    files["Generated/Src/platform_resources.c"] = _PlatformResources_Render(
        ground_model, catalog
    ).encode("utf-8")
    files["Generated/Inc/ground_radio_config.h"] = GroundRadioConfig_Render(ground).encode("utf-8")
    files["Generated/Inc/air_link_config.h"] = GroundRadioAirHeader_Render(
        ground, AirLinkHeader_Render(model, target="ground")).encode("utf-8")
    files["Generated/Src/pc_byte_stream.c"] = _PcAdapter_Render(model, family).encode("utf-8")

    base_graph = SourceGraph_Resolve(ground_model, catalog)
